description: Returns the balance of given account address in wei.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The address (20 bytes) to check for balance

parameters.name: blockNumber
parameters.description: The block number in hexadecimal format or the string latest, earliest, pending, safe or finalized (safe and finalized tags are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova and Avalanche C-chain), see the default block parameter description in the official Ethereum documentation

result.description: The ETH balance of the specified address in hexadecimal value, measured in wei
